meta.title: Strategy Research Register — signals, validation gates, correlation, luck removal
meta.principle: A strategy is a pre-registered rule that maps verified information to bet selections. It may score on the leaderboard only after passing every validation gate. All parameter values below are MODEL PARAMETERS or literature-anchored estimates unless a row says 'computed here'.

signals.name: Own-line discrepancy (spread)
signals.definition: modelSpreadHome - marketSpreadHome beyond a threshold (default 3.0 pts after de-vigging).
signals.dataNeeded: model lines (have), market reference (have via DraftKings/ESPN, labelled)

signals.name: Lineup-deficiency imbalance
signals.definition: difference in modelled injury points between the two teams of a game (injuryAdjAwayPts - injuryAdjHomePts) beyond 1.5 pts, in the direction the market has not priced (checked against the market move if available).
signals.dataNeeded: official injury report + club depth charts (have)

signals.name: Backup-QB downgrade
signals.definition: opponent faces a 2nd/3rd-string QB starter (depth-chart confirmed) and the market line has not fully adjusted (model-market edge still positive).
signals.dataNeeded: depth charts + news of official starter naming (nfl.com news used only as labelled context)

signals.name: Rest/spot asymmetry
signals.definition: rest-day difference or international/short-week spot not reflected in the model-market edge.

signals.name: Cluster-injury defense
signals.definition: two or more same-unit defensive starters out (e.g., CB1 + S1) — pass-game exposure signal for opponent player props.
signals.dataNeeded: injury report + depth charts (have); prop market (missing — Q5)

signals.name: Positive-feedback prop combo
signals.definition: player-prop legs on the same game whose joint hit probability exceeds the product of marginals by a documented correlation factor (see correlation table).

strategies.name: Single: model-market edge
strategies.rule: Bet the side the model favours when |edgeSpreadPts| >= 3.0 AND the lineup signal agrees or is neutral; otherwise pass.
strategies.notes: Week-10 live board would have produced passes on JAX/TEN, BUF/NYJ, CAR/NO, SF/DAL per current edges; edges are v0 and gates G4/G5 need pick volume.

strategies.name: Single: total discrepancy
strategies.rule: Bet Over/Under the model side when |edgeTotalPts| >= 2.5; no injury adjustment applied to totals in v0 (known limitation).
strategies.notes: Current board shows model totals below market in 8 of 13 games (v0 bias to Under; must pass G4 calibration before scoring).

strategies.name: Parlay: 2-leg cross-game edge stack
strategies.rule: Two single-qualifying legs from DIFFERENT games; combined price must clear the product of true probabilities by the correlation haircut (independent legs: multiply fair probabilities; never stack positively-correlated legs without the matrix).
strategies.notes: Cross-game legs are approximately independent (see correlation table); same-game legs are NOT.

strategies.name: Same-game parlay: correlated core
strategies.rule: Team ML/Spread + game total + at most one correlated player prop on the SAME game; stake scaled by the empirical correlation matrix (frozen at pre-launch estimates until enough samples exist).
strategies.notes: SGP correlation structure is the single biggest luck amplifier; the matrix cell values below are ESTIMATES pending the S5 job.

strategies.name: Player-prop combo: usage-driven
strategies.rule: 2-3 prop legs built from verified usage drivers (target share/carry share on official stats) plus lineup-deficiency signals; each leg needs its own edge vs a modelled baseline; combos capped at 3 legs.
strategies.notes: No official prop market is verified; modelled baselines would be labelled MODEL OUTPUT and graded on raw outcomes only.

validationGates.name: Pre-registration lock
validationGates.definition: Strategy rule + parameters timestamped before the first graded kickoff; no mid-week edits (edits create a new strategy ID).
validationGates.measurement: git/JSON timestamps vs official kickoff times.

validationGates.name: Verified-inputs-only
validationGates.definition: Every input in the decision path traces to an official source row or a labelled MODEL OUTPUT; unverified cells force a pass.

validationGates.name: Parameter disclosure
validationGates.definition: All weights/thresholds published with the strategy; changes require a new version and re-validation.

validationGates.name: Calibration sample
validationGates.definition: N >= 100 graded picks before rewards; model MAE tracked weekly (first point: WAS@NYG error 5.2 pts, side loss).

validationGates.name: Skill, not luck (statistical)
validationGates.definition: 95% bootstrap CI of ROI must clear 0 after shrinkage toward the mean; closing-line value positive on average (when market snapshots exist).

validationGates.name: Exposure discipline
validationGates.definition: Quarter-Kelly stake cap 3% of bankroll, weekly exposure cap 10%, no compounding of parlays.

validationGates.name: Correlation audit
validationGates.definition: Every multi-leg ticket declares its correlation assumptions; same-game tickets must use the published matrix or a conservative floor (max rho = 0.35 until measured).

correlation.status: FRAMEWORK PUBLISHED — empirical values pending (Q10). Values below are literature-anchored estimates, NOT computed here, and are flagged unverified until the S5 job runs.
correlation.estimator: phi coefficient between binary leg outcomes on graded same-game samples; shrunk toward 0 with prior weight 20; published with sample size per cell.

matrix.basis: roughly symmetric historically; must be measured

matrix.pair: team total over & game total over (same game)
matrix.status: part-whole identity, direction certain; magnitude unverified

matrix.pair: QB passing yards over & team total over (same game)
RB rushing yards over & team win (same game)
player prop & opponent player prop (same game)

correlation.rule: Until measured, same-game staking uses rho floor 0.35 for positively-linked legs and treats the parlay as its own correlated exposure unit (G7).

principles: Grade on closing-line value (CLV) as well as outcomes: a strategy that beats the close repeatedly has skill even in a losing month (needs Q4/Q17 resolved).
Shrink ROI toward the mean: shrunkROI = (n*ROI + k*0)/(n+k) with k = 25; publish n beside every score.
Bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 resamples of the pick ledger); rewards require the interval to clear zero.
Deflate parlays: expected variance of a parlay grows superlinearly; count a parlay as its legs for sample-size purposes.
Separate 'process score' (did the strategy follow its own rules?) from 'outcome score' — process errors invalidate the week regardless of result.
Report luck-adjusted rank = shrunkROI rank + CLV rank blend (60/40), never raw ROI alone.
